subject: iOS findings from the Ponytail audit + ECC verification (2 HIGH) — native lane
body:
Cloud lane, 2026-09-01. Ponytail is now the top review layer (DR-024) and ran its first whole-repo audit; ECC verified the cut list. Two iOS items are yours (native lane), both ECC-confirmed:

1. HIGH — platform honesty (CLAUDE.md rule 4). native/ios/EnterpriseShell/Utilities/DeviceInfo.swift:67-92 reads serialNumber / udid / isSupervised / isKioskMode straight from ProcessInfo environment variables under comments claiming "requires MDM/Enterprise". An app cannot obtain these; today they are env reads dressed as MDM facts. Consumers: serialNumber feeds SecurityManager.swift:75, SessionStateManager.swift:283,370, AuditLogger.swift:150, IdentityProvider.swift:475 as an identity/log label; isSupervised/isKioskMode have zero consumers. Fix: route them through the existing DemoMode.swift pattern so they can never masquerade as genuine device facts in a non-demo build, and keep device_serial out of any backend-bound identity/authz payload unless demo-flagged.

2. HIGH — HybridIdentityProvider.authenticate never assigns primaryProvider (IdentityProvider.swift:589-648), so after a successful auth isAuthenticated is false and refreshToken()/revokeAuthentication() are silent no-ops. Live-reachable via IDENTITY_PROVIDER_TYPE=hybrid (ProviderConfigurationService.swift:117). ECC's verdict: the Ponytail cut (retire the MDM/MFA/Hybrid identity-provider stubs, keep OIDCIdentityProvider + DemoIdentityProvider) is the correct fix — it retires the bug rather than patching a class with no real second factor behind it. Companion Ponytail cuts in the same area, all GO: USBCBadgeReaderProvider.swift (unreachable: registered under "usbc", no BadgeReaderType case), the badge-reader plug-in registry stubs (HTTPWebhook/MDM providers, .nfc/.serial with no factory), ProviderConfigurationService's uncalled surface (keep getBadgeReaderProvider()/getIdentityProvider(), which SessionStateManager.swift:55,59 use — confirm they do not depend on the SecurityConfig/BackendConfig construction being removed), native/ios/setup.sh, SignalGridMobile/FILES.txt, run-code-analysis.sh (swiftlint already covers its seven rules). Also LOW: BadgeReaderProviderFactory returns nil for .nfc/.serial and SessionStateManager proceeds (optional-chained, so fail-closed in effect) — a startup assertion would make the misconfiguration loud. Full report: docs/agent/PONYTAIL_AUDIT_2026-09-01.md (scripts+native section) and the ECC verdict tables in the same PR series.

The two Postgres-only proofs first queued for you are NOT needed: the cloud container has Postgres 16 binaries, so migration v3 and every pg proof (audit-ledger-pg 22/22, decision-store-pg, db-role-split, backup-restore, verify-ledger) ran here on a disposable cluster and are recorded in the PR that follows #364. Your queue from this lane is only the two iOS items above and the native Ponytail cuts.
